description: This file defines a mock class for the INetworkManager interface, used for unit testing network management functionalities within the WPEFramework project. It includes mock method declarations for various network operations and interactions.

classes.name: MockINetworkManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of the WPEFramework::Exchange::INetworkManager interface for testing purposes, providing mock methods for network operations.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of available network interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of the primary network interface.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Mocks enabling or disabling a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Mocks querying the state of a network interface.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks retrieving IP settings for a specified interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Mocks setting IP configuration for an interface.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the STUN server endpoint details.

methods.name: SetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Mocks configuring the STUN server endpoint.

methods.name: GetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Mocks obtaining endpoints used for connectivity testing.

methods.name: SetConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Mocks setting endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the URI of captive portal.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the device's public IP address.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Mocks adding a WiFi SSID to known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Mocks removing a known WiFi SSID.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Mocks connecting to a WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Mocks retrieving current connected SSID info.

methods.name: GetLogLevel
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the current log level.
